There is no `pkgver()` function. The `prepare()`, `build()`, `check()`, and `package_*()` functions are present but will NOT execute during `makepkg --nobuild --noprepare` or `--printsrcinfo`. No malicious patterns (eval, base64 decode, curl|bash, obfuscation, unexpected network destinations, or data exfiltration) are present.
</details>
